## `neuro.array.from`

Static method on `Array`.

> Creates an array from an array-like object.
>
> Creates an array from an iterable object.

## Signatures

```ts
from(input: { arrayLike: ArrayLike<T>; prompt?: string }): Promise<T[]>
from(input: { arrayLike: ArrayLike<T>; mapfn?: (v: T; k: number) => U; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<U[]>
from(input: { iterable: Iterable<T> | ArrayLike<T>; prompt?: string }): Promise<T[]>
from(input: { iterable: Iterable<T> | ArrayLike<T>; mapfn?: (v: T; k: number) => U; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<U[]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.from` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
